deficits.evidence: There is no designated sidewalk for pedestrians on the right side of the road.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a purpose-built sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

deficits.evidence: The informal path on the left is unpaved and uneven.
deficits.suggestion: Pave the informal path on the left to remove trip hazards and improve accessibility.

deficits.evidence: There is high crossing demand due to commercial buildings on the right, but no designated crossing facility.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe point for people to cross the road.

ratings.reason: The right side lacks a formal sidewalk, and building one is a standard feasible fix.
The left side shows an unpaved, uneven shoulder that would be improved by paving.
Commercial activity is visible on the right, but no marked crossing is present in the frames.
